prompt_vars.data:
Period: Q3 2024 Post-Mortem — Fulfillment Disruption Event
Event: Carrier network outage affecting DACH region, 4 days in August 2024
Impacted orders: 14,200 (estimated)
Revenue at risk: 1.24M EUR
Actual revenue loss (cancellations + refunds): 187K EUR
Customer contacts related to event: 8,940 (vs daily average of 420)
NPS impact: -6 points during event window (recovered to -2 vs pre-event after 3 weeks)
Cost of resolution (expedited shipping, refunds, vouchers): 94K EUR
Root cause: Single-carrier dependency for 68% of DACH shipments
Mitigation actions taken: Emergency activation of secondary carrier; 12% of affected orders rerouted
Context: SLA with primary carrier required 72-hour notice for capacity requests; no backup SLA in place
prompt_vars.audience: Operations Director and Risk Management team
prompt_vars.sections: Executive Summary, Incident Timeline and Impact, Financial Impact Assessment, Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Actions and Recommendations
